captions.detailed: An industrial portable air scrubber consisting of a tall, dark blue boxy housing mounted on four small black casters. The front face features a rectangular louvred intake grille on its upper half, and a black hinged access door with a silver vertical handle and orange trim on the lower half. The front door is designed to swing open on its left-edge revolute hinges, while a four-stage filter stack is engineered to slide out of the housing on bottom guide rails.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an industrial portable air scrubber with a tall, boxy dark-blue housing mounted on casters. The front should feature an upper louvred grille and a lower black access door with a silver handle that pivots on left-side hinges, housing an internal filter stack designed to slide out.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing using a hollowed-out Box primitive with a front opening. Model the casters using small Cylinder wheels and Box brackets, placing them at the bottom four corners. Create the front door from a Box with an attached handle (made from cylindrical sweeps) and hinge knuckles along its left vertical edge. Build the upper grille by patterning thin horizontal and vertical Box slats. Finally, structure the internal filter stack as a rectangular block and assemble the parts using a revolute joint for the door and a prismatic joint for the sliding filter stack.
